rows.en:
(The Practical Test is coming up soon,
so maybe I'll get in some training
on my own today.)

Oh, if it isn't \p.
You showed up at just the right time.

Yes. The thing is, the Pilot Course got a job
request asking us to perform EX-Gear
acrobatics at a concert.
rows.notes: Luca, answering the player's 'Need something from me?'. Koukuuka = Pilot Course (glossary).

rows.en:
So we'd like you to be in that concert too...
That's no problem, right?
rows.notes: Michel asks the player to perform.

rows.en:
What?!
Are you sure it's okay for someone like me
to be in it?

With your skills, \p-san,
it won't be a problem at all.

We're giving you our seal of approval.
So go in with some confidence.
rows.notes: Michel. Taikoban wo osu = vouch for, guarantee.

rows.en:
Michel... Luca...
All right, I'd love to perform too!

Great, so that settles the performers
for the 'Sheryl' concert.
No problem there, right, Luca?
rows.notes: The Japanese sets Sheryl in quotes; the player has not caught on yet. Kept the quotes.

rows.en:
Right.
Now all that's left is to decide on the
acrobatics program for the 'Sheryl' concert!

...Huh? What?
...What do you mean, the 'Sheryl' concert?

What?! \p-san...
Don't tell me you don't know
about the famous Sheryl?

If the Sheryl you're talking about, Luca,
is 'Sheryl Nome,'
then of course I know her...
Wait, you really mean the Galactic Fairy...?

Yeah. We're going to be in the concert
of the Galactic Fairy, 'Sheryl Nome.'
Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!!!
Y-you're kidding me, right?! Luca?!

No, of course it's true,
\p-san.

We'll be flying at Sheryl's concert.
If we messed up, it'd be a disaster...

That's true.
If we messed up...

Come on, don't you two suddenly
put that kind of pressure on me...

Haha, I'm just kidding.
Like I said, you'll do just fine.

Besides, Sheryl's concert or not,
what we're doing is no different from usual.
Let's just take it easy.

Sigh... There's no way I can
shrug it off like you, Michel, but...

Yeah! I'll perform at
Sheryl's concert too.
...Besides, I'd like to meet Sheryl.
Heh, I'm counting on you, \p.

(I'm going to be performing at Sheryl Nome's
concert... I still can't believe it...)

(I'll actually get to meet the Galactic Fairy...
I'd better at least be ready
to get an autograph...)

What?!
Are you sure it's okay for someone like me
to be in it?

Michel-kun... Luca-kun...
All right, I'd love to perform too!

If the Sheryl you're talking about, Luca-kun,
is 'Sheryl Nome,'
then of course I know her...
Y-you're kidding me, right?! Luca-kun?!

Come on, don't you two suddenly
put that kind of pressure on me...

Sigh... There's no way I can
shrug it off like you, Michel-kun, but...

Yeah! I'll perform at
Sheryl's concert too.

(I'm going to be performing at Sheryl Nome's
concert... I still can't believe it...)

(I'll actually get to meet the Galactic Fairy...
I'd better at least be ready
to get an autograph...)

(There was a rumor that a transfer student
was coming to our class, so I was looking
forward to seeing who it'd be, but...)

I'm Ranka Lee, and I've transferred into
the Performing Arts Course.
It's nice to meet you all!
rows.notes: x4 (also scd_fes_201). Geinou course = Performing Arts Course, a provisional glossary entry.

rows.en:
(I never imagined the transfer student
would be Ranka...)

That was a surprise.
I never thought you'd transfer to Mihoshi,
Ranka.

Hehe, I kept it a secret from everyone.
If you were surprised, then it worked
perfectly!
But why did you transfer to Mihoshi, anyway?

Well, the thing is...
I got scouted by a talent agency and started
working, so I couldn't stay at my old school.

So I took Mihoshi's transfer exam.
I was so nervous~ It's famous for being
tough, with practical exams and everything.
rows.notes: Ranka; x4 (also scd_fes_201). Reflowed within 3 lines.

rows.en:
And you passed, so as of today
you're a Mihoshi student, huh?

Yep, that's right.
So look out for me at school too from now on,
\p-kun.
rows.notes: Ranka; also scd_fes_201. Korekara wa gakkou demo yoroshiku.

rows.en:
Okay, I'm going to go say hi to Alto-kun
and the others too. See you, \p-kun.

(Ranka transferring here was a surprise,
but now we get to enjoy school life together.)

(It'd be nice if Ranka and I could get
even closer than before......)

(Wait, there's a commotion in the schoolyard.
What's going on?)

(Huh?! That's Sheryl, isn't it...?
Why is the Galactic Fairy at Mihoshi?!)

(It's been a few days since Sheryl's surprise
visit, and Mihoshi should've calmed down
by now, but...)

(How did it come to this?
How......)

I've transferred into the Pilot Course.
I'm Sheryl Nome.
rows.notes: x4 (also scd_fes_201). Pairotto koosu = Pilot Course (glossary alias).

rows.en:
(The Galactic Fairy, Sheryl Nome,
has transferred to Mihoshi!!)

I transferred here because I wanted
to get a little taste of high school life.
Nice to meet you.

(Not just Ranka, but even THE Sheryl
transferring here...)
(This really isn't a dream... is it...?)

(I never imagined the transfer student
would be Ranka-chan...)

That was a surprise.
I never thought you'd transfer to Mihoshi,
Ranka-chan.

And you passed, so as of today
you're a Mihoshi student, right?

Yep, that's right.
So look out for me at school too from now on,
\p-chan.

Okay, I'm going to go say hi to Alto-kun
and the others too. See you, \p-chan.

(Ranka-chan transferring here was a surprise,
but now we get to enjoy school life together.)

(It'd be nice if Ranka-chan and I could get
even closer than before......)

(Wait, there's a commotion in the schoolyard.
What's going on?)

(Huh?! That's Sheryl, isn't it...?
Why is the Galactic Fairy at Mihoshi?!)

(How did it come to this?
How......)

(The Galactic Fairy, Sheryl Nome,
has transferred to Mihoshi!!)

(Not just Ranka-chan, but even THE Sheryl
transferring here...)
rows.notes: The female player says bare 'Sheryl' here (no -san), as in the Japanese.

rows.en: (This really isn't a dream... is it...?)

uncertain: c23015: Geinou course = 'Performing Arts Course', glossary entry still provisional.
